blocks.zh: 概覽：IND 目的、豁免條件與 CDMO 關聯性
blocks.en: Overview: IND Purpose, Exemptions and Relevance to CDMOs

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 解釋 IND 的法律依據（FD&C Act §505(i)）及其核心目的——保護人體受試者並使 FDA 在人體試驗前得以審查安全性資料
blocks.en: Explain the legal basis of the IND (FD&C Act §505(i)) and its core purpose: protecting human subjects and allowing FDA to review safety data before human trials begin

blocks.zh: 區分 IND 與 NDA/BLA 的本質差異：IND 是申請（request），不是批准（approval）；30 天後自動生效，除非 FDA 發出臨床擱置
blocks.en: Distinguish the IND from an NDA/BLA: an IND is a request, not an approval; it goes into effect automatically after 30 days unless FDA imposes a clinical hold

blocks.zh: 熟悉 §312.2 所列的所有豁免類型，並能判斷特定研究情境是否需要申請 IND
blocks.en: Become familiar with all exemption types listed in §312.2 and be able to judge whether a given study scenario requires an IND

blocks.zh: 說明 Phase 1、2、3 的核心定義及其對 CMC（化學製造與管制）要求的逐步遞增影響
blocks.en: Describe the core definitions of Phase 1, 2 and 3 and how CMC (chemistry, manufacturing and controls) requirements increase progressively across them

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 合約製造商角度，識別 Part 312 的直接義務：製造規格合規、偏差通報、製程變更管理
blocks.en: From the standpoint of a CDMO (contract manufacturer), identify the direct obligations under Part 312: compliance with manufacturing specifications, deviation reporting and process change management

blocks.zh: 0.1 What Is an IND and Why Does It Exist? 0.1 何謂 IND 及其存在的原因？
blocks.en: 0.1 What Is an IND and Why Does It Exist?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — IND vs NDA：申請 ≠ 批准
blocks.en: Core Concept: IND vs NDA - A Request Is Not an Approval

blocks.zh: IND（試驗中新藥申請） 是一份「我想要開始做人體試驗」的通知書，不是 FDA 的批准文件。IND 的生效方式是「沉默同意」——FDA 在 30 天內未發出臨床擱置，即視為有效。
blocks.en: An IND (Investigational New Drug application) is a notice stating "we intend to begin human trials"; it is not an FDA approval document. An IND goes into effect by "silent consent": if FDA does not issue a clinical hold within 30 days, the IND is considered effective.

blocks.zh: NDA / BLA（新藥申請 / 生物製品許可申請） 才是真正的「上市批准」——需要 FDA 審查全部 Phase 1–3 的安全性與有效性資料後，主動核發批准函。
blocks.en: An NDA / BLA (New Drug Application / Biologics License Application) is the true "marketing approval": FDA reviews the full safety and efficacy data from Phases 1-3 and then actively issues an approval letter.

blocks.zh: 簡單對照：IND = 向城市申請「動工許可」（開工前等 30 天看是否被叫停）；NDA/BLA = 最終的「使用執照」（需要驗收合格才能核發）。
blocks.en: Simple comparison: an IND is like applying to the city for a "construction start permit" (you wait 30 days to see whether you are told to stop before work begins); an NDA/BLA is the final "occupancy certificate" (issued only after the building passes inspection).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — IND 是「建築開工許可」
blocks.en: Analogy: An IND Is a "Building Start Permit"

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一棟醫院（開發一個新藥）：
blocks.en: Imagine you are building a hospital (developing a new drug):

blocks.zh: IND 就是你向城市規劃局（FDA）提交「施工申請書」。你繳交設計圖（CMC 資料）、土地安全報告（動物毒理學）和施工計畫（臨床方案）。
blocks.en: The IND is the "construction application" you submit to the city planning office (FDA). You hand in the blueprints (CMC data), the site safety report (animal toxicology) and the construction plan (clinical protocol).

blocks.zh: 城市局有 30 天 審查你的計畫。如果他們認為施工會危及周邊居民（受試者安全疑慮），他們會發出「停工令」（clinical hold）。
blocks.en: The city office has 30 days to review your plan. If it believes construction would endanger nearby residents (a subject safety concern), it issues a "stop-work order" (clinical hold).

blocks.zh: 如果 30 天過了什麼都沒說，你就可以開工（開始人體試驗）。
blocks.en: If 30 days pass and nothing is said, you may start building (begin human trials).

blocks.zh: NDA/BLA 是最終的「建築驗收合格書」——蓋完整棟醫院、全部驗收通過後才能正式開業（上市銷售）。
blocks.en: The NDA/BLA is the final "certificate of completion": only after the whole hospital is built and has passed every inspection can it formally open (go on the market).

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：開工不需要城市局「批准」，只需要他們「不反對」。上市才需要他們正式核發許可。
blocks.en: The key difference: starting work does not require the city office to "approve" you, only to "not object". Going to market requires a formal permit.

blocks.zh: 常見誤解澄清 Common Misconception
blocks.en: Common Misconception

blocks.zh: 誤解：「IND 就是 FDA 批准可以做人體試驗」
blocks.en: Misconception: "An IND means FDA has approved human trials"

blocks.zh: 正確觀念： IND 生效是 FDA 的「不干預」，而非「主動批准」。差異在於：若 FDA 審查發現安全疑慮，他們可以在 30 天內發出臨床擱置（clinical hold）而不必主動核發任何許可文件。
blocks.en: Correct understanding: An IND becoming effective means FDA has "not intervened", not that it has "actively approved". The difference is that if FDA finds a safety concern during review, it can impose a clinical hold within 30 days without having to issue any permission document.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：CDMO 若看到客戶說「IND 已批准」，需要核實說法是否準確——正確說法應為「IND 已生效 (IND is effective)」。
blocks.en: This means that when a client tells a CDMO "the IND has been approved", the CDMO should verify whether the statement is accurate. The correct wording is "the IND is effective".

blocks.zh: 0.2 §312.1 — Scope: When Is an IND Required? 0.2 §312.1 — 適用範圍：何時需要 IND？
blocks.en: 0.2 §312.1 - Scope: When Is an IND Required?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三要件同時成立才需要 IND
blocks.en: Core Concept: An IND Is Required Only When All Three Conditions Are Met

blocks.zh: IND 要求的觸發需要三個條件同時成立：
blocks.en: The requirement for an IND is triggered only when three conditions are met at the same time:

blocks.zh: 條件 1： 藥品在美國尚未獲批上市（或使用超出核准範圍）
blocks.en: Condition 1: The drug is not yet approved for marketing in the US (or is used outside its approved scope)

blocks.zh: 條件 2： 用於人體臨床試驗
blocks.en: Condition 2: It is used in a human clinical investigation

blocks.zh: 條件 3： 跨州運輸
blocks.en: Condition 3: It is shipped across state lines

blocks.zh: 只要其中一個條件不成立，就可能不需要 IND（但仍須評估其他豁免條件）。
blocks.en: If any one condition is not met, an IND may not be required (but the other exemption criteria still need to be evaluated).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 — 哪些情況 CDMO 會碰到 IND 相關藥品？
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: When Does a CDMO Encounter IND-Related Drugs?

blocks.zh: Phase 1 臨床批次製造： 客戶提供 IND 號碼，要求 CDMO 製造首批人體試驗用藥品（藥品跨州送到臨床試驗機構 → IND 必要）
blocks.en: Phase 1 clinical batch manufacture: The client provides an IND number and asks the CDMO to manufacture the first batch for human trials (the drug is shipped across state lines to clinical sites, so an IND is necessary)

blocks.zh: 已上市藥品的新適應症試驗： 客戶持有核准 NDA，但現在要用同一藥品做癌症新適應症 → 超出核准範圍 → 需要新的 IND
blocks.en: Trials of a new indication for a marketed drug: The client holds an approved NDA but now wants to use the same drug for a new cancer indication, which is outside the approved scope, so a new IND is needed

blocks.zh: 生物相似藥研發： 生物相似藥在申請 BLA 前，也可能需要 IND 來進行臨床比對試驗
blocks.en: Biosimilar development: Before filing a BLA, a biosimilar may also need an IND to run comparative clinical studies

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 「州際商業」觸發條件
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Interstate Commerce" Trigger

blocks.zh: 實務上，幾乎所有多中心臨床試驗都會跨州（藥品從製造場地運到各臨床試驗機構），因此「跨州」條件幾乎必然成立。
blocks.en: In practice, almost every multicenter clinical trial crosses state lines (the drug moves from the manufacturing site to the various clinical sites), so the "interstate" condition is almost always met.

blocks.zh: CDMO 工廠在加州製造藥品，送到紐約的臨床試驗中心 → 跨州 → IND 適用。就算製造廠和試驗中心在同一州，FDA 的規管範圍也涵蓋一切影響州際商業的藥品，實際上很難完全規避 IND 要求。
blocks.en: A CDMO plant in California manufactures a drug and ships it to a clinical trial center in New York: interstate, so the IND applies. Even if the plant and the trial center are in the same state, FDA's jurisdiction covers all drugs that affect interstate commerce, so it is very difficult in practice to avoid the IND requirement entirely.

blocks.zh: 0.3 §312.2 — Exemptions from IND Requirement 0.3 §312.2 — IND 要求的豁免情形
blocks.en: 0.3 §312.2 - Exemptions from IND Requirement

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 豁免 ≠ 無監管
blocks.en: Core Concept: Exempt Does Not Mean Unregulated

blocks.zh: 豁免 IND 要求並不代表研究完全不受監管。所有豁免項目仍必須遵守：
blocks.en: Being exempt from the IND requirement does not mean a study is entirely unregulated. All exempt studies must still comply with:

blocks.zh: IRB（機構審查委員會）審查義務（21 CFR Part 56）
blocks.en: IRB (Institutional Review Board) review obligations (21 CFR Part 56)

blocks.zh: 知情同意要求（21 CFR Part 50）
blocks.en: Informed consent requirements (21 CFR Part 50)

blocks.zh: 適用的 CGMP 要求（Parts 210/211）
blocks.en: Applicable CGMP requirements (Parts 210/211)

blocks.zh: 豁免只是「不需要向 FDA 提交 IND 文件」，不是「免除一切法規義務」。
blocks.en: An exemption only means "no IND document needs to be submitted to FDA"; it does not mean "all regulatory obligations are waived".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 豁免的邏輯：已有「信用紀錄」的藥品
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of Exemption - A Drug with a "Credit History"

blocks.zh: 把 IND 申請比作「信用審查」：一個全新藥品（NCE）沒有任何安全紀錄，FDA 必須從頭審查，就像銀行對新客戶做嚴格信用調查。
blocks.en: Think of the IND application as a "credit check": a brand-new drug (NCE) has no safety record, so FDA must review it from scratch, like a bank running a strict credit investigation on a new customer.

blocks.zh: 已上市藥品（lawfully marketed drug）已有多年的安全紀錄，如果你只是用它做標準的 BE 研究或常規臨床使用，FDA 允許「跳過信用審查」——因為風險輪廓已充分了解。
blocks.en: A lawfully marketed drug already has years of safety history. If you only use it for a standard BE study or routine clinical use, FDA allows you to "skip the credit check" because the risk profile is already well understood.

blocks.zh: 但一旦你把這個「信用良好」的藥品用於全新適應症、全新劑量或高風險族群，風險輪廓改變，就必須重新申請 IND。
blocks.en: But once you use this "good credit" drug for a brand-new indication, a new dose or a high-risk population, the risk profile changes and you must file an IND.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 — 需要 IND 還是豁免？
blocks.en: Exercise: IND Required or Exempt?

blocks.zh: 判斷以下情境是否需要 IND：
blocks.en: Decide whether an IND is required in each of the following scenarios:

blocks.zh:
藥廠對已核准的降壓藥品做 BA 研究，比較原廠錠劑與新配方膠囊（同劑量、同適應症）。
→ 可能適用 §312.2(b)(1) BE 豁免
blocks.en:
A pharmaceutical company runs a BA study on an approved antihypertensive, comparing the original tablet with a new capsule formulation (same dose, same indication).
→ The §312.2(b)(1) BE exemption may apply

blocks.zh:
研究者在美國大學研究已核准的化療藥品用於一種罕見新癌症，跨州送樣品。
→ 新適應症 + 跨州 = 需要 IND
blocks.en:
A researcher at a US university studies an approved chemotherapy drug for a rare new cancer and ships samples across state lines.
→ New indication + interstate shipment = IND required

blocks.zh:
歐洲進行的 Phase 2 試驗，數據將用於支持美國 NDA 申請。
→ 不強制需要美國 IND，但數據必須符合 FDA 標準與 ICH E6 GCP
blocks.en:
A Phase 2 trial conducted in Europe whose data will support a US NDA.
→ A US IND is not necessarily required, but the data must meet FDA standards and ICH E6 GCP

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — BA/BE 豁免的實務意涵
blocks.en: Key Point: Practical Implications of the BA/BE Exemption

blocks.zh: BA/BE 豁免（§312.2(b)(1)）是學名藥產業最常用的豁免條款。CDMO 承接 ANDA（學名藥申請）相關的 BE 研究批次製造時，客戶通常不需要 IND——但 CDMO 仍需：
blocks.en: The BA/BE exemption (§312.2(b)(1)) is the exemption most commonly used in the generic drug industry. When a CDMO manufactures BE study batches for an ANDA (generic drug application), the client usually does not need an IND, but the CDMO must still:

blocks.zh: 確認豁免條件全部成立（非放射性標記、非新適應症等）
blocks.en: Confirm that all exemption conditions are met (not radiolabeled, not a new indication, etc.)

blocks.zh: 以符合 CGMP 的方式製造 BE 研究批次
blocks.en: Manufacture the BE study batches in a CGMP-compliant manner

blocks.zh: 保留完整的製造和放行紀錄
blocks.en: Retain complete manufacturing and release records

blocks.zh: 0.4 IND Phases — Key Definitions & CMC Implications 0.4 IND 各期別 — 關鍵定義與 CMC 意涵
blocks.en: 0.4 IND Phases - Key Definitions & CMC Implications

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Phase 1/2/3 的製程成熟度就像「建房三階段」
blocks.en: Analogy: Process Maturity in Phases 1/2/3 Is Like the "Three Stages of Building a House"

blocks.zh: Phase 1 = 打地基： 你只需要讓基礎安全，不需要裝潢細節。製程可以不完美，但不能有安全疑慮。
blocks.en: Phase 1 = Laying the foundation: You only need the foundation to be safe; the finishing details are not needed. The process can be imperfect, but there must be no safety concerns.

blocks.zh: Phase 2 = 蓋主體結構： 牆壁要筆直，門窗要合規格，開始需要建築師圖說（製程規格文件）。
blocks.en: Phase 2 = Building the main structure: The walls must be straight and the doors and windows must meet specification; you begin to need the architect's drawings (process specification documents).

blocks.zh: Phase 3 = 完工準備入住： 所有細節必須與最終核准的建築圖（商業製程）完全一致，因為之後不能隨意改動——改動需要向主管機關申報（manufacturing change supplement）。
blocks.en: Phase 3 = Ready for move-in: Every detail must match the final approved building plan (the commercial process) exactly, because changes cannot be made casually afterwards; changes must be reported to the authority (manufacturing change supplement).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Phase-Appropriate GMP
blocks.en: Key Point: Phase-Appropriate GMP

blocks.zh: 「Phase-appropriate GMP」是 FDA 的彈性原則——但彈性有邊界：
blocks.en: "Phase-appropriate GMP" is FDA's principle of flexibility, but the flexibility has limits:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 不需要完整的製程驗證，但需要有風險基礎的品質管制措施（如無菌填充的無菌保證、原料身份確認）
blocks.en: Phase 1 does not require full process validation, but it does require risk-based quality control measures (such as sterility assurance for aseptic filling and raw material identity confirmation)

blocks.zh: FDA 在 Phase 1 稽查時，焦點在「藥品是否安全用於人體」，而非追求完美的 CGMP 合規性
blocks.en: In a Phase 1 inspection, FDA focuses on whether "the drug is safe for use in humans", not on perfect CGMP compliance

blocks.zh: 任何 Phase 的藥品，都必須做到：正確標示（labeling）、無菌性保證（如適用）、無交叉污染（cross-contamination prevention）
blocks.en: A drug at any phase must have: correct labeling, sterility assurance (where applicable) and prevention of cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 0.5 Why Part 312 Matters for CDMOs 0.5 Part 312 對 CDMO 的重要性
blocks.en: 0.5 Why Part 312 Matters for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Sponsor vs CDMO 的責任分工
blocks.en: Core Concept: Division of Responsibility Between Sponsor and CDMO

blocks.zh: Part 312 的法律責任架構如下：
blocks.en: The legal responsibility structure under Part 312 is as follows:

blocks.zh: Sponsor（贊助廠商）：持有 IND、對 FDA 負責、承擔所有申報義務（IND amendment、安全報告等）
blocks.en: Sponsor: holds the IND, is accountable to FDA and bears all reporting obligations (IND amendments, safety reports, etc.)

blocks.zh: CDMO（合約製造商）：依據 IND CMC 規格製造、對 Sponsor 負責、維持 GMP 合規性
blocks.en: CDMO (contract manufacturer): manufactures according to the IND CMC specifications, is accountable to the Sponsor and maintains GMP compliance

blocks.zh: CDMO 雖然不直接向 FDA 申報 IND，但 FDA 稽查時可以直接到 CDMO 工廠稽查製造紀錄。CDMO 的合規狀況直接影響 Sponsor IND 的有效性。
blocks.en: Although a CDMO does not submit INDs to FDA directly, FDA can inspect the CDMO's plant and review its manufacturing records directly. The CDMO's compliance status directly affects the validity of the Sponsor's IND.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Sponsor 是「建案開發商」，CDMO 是「建築承包商」。開發商對業主（FDA）負責，但如果承包商偷工減料，建案一樣會被勒令停工。
blocks.en: Analogy: the Sponsor is the "property developer" and the CDMO is the "building contractor". The developer answers to the owner (FDA), but if the contractor cuts corners, the project will still be ordered to stop.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境 — 客戶要求製造 Phase 1 批次，CDMO 應如何應對？
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: A Client Requests a Phase 1 Batch. How Should the CDMO Respond?

blocks.zh: 情境： 一家生技公司（Sponsor）請 CDMO 製造其 Phase 1 臨床試驗用小分子藥品，該客戶擁有有效的 IND（IND 號碼 XXXXX）。
blocks.en: Scenario: A biotech company (the Sponsor) asks a CDMO to manufacture a small-molecule drug for its Phase 1 clinical trial. The client holds an effective IND (IND number XXXXX).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應立即確認的項目：
blocks.en: Items the CDMO should confirm immediately:

blocks.zh: 取得 IND CMC 章節副本：確認製造方法、規格、分析程序與 IND 描述一致
blocks.en: Obtain a copy of the IND CMC section: confirm that the manufacturing method, specifications and analytical procedures are consistent with the IND description

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）：明確訂定偏差通報時限（通常 24 小時內通知 Sponsor）、製程變更預先通知義務、FDA 稽查時的通知機制
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: clearly define the deviation reporting timeframe (usually notification of the Sponsor within 24 hours), the obligation to give advance notice of process changes, and the mechanism for notification during FDA inspections

blocks.zh: 製造紀錄設計：確保批次記錄足以支持 FDA 稽查，且與 IND 描述的製程步驟對應
blocks.en: Manufacturing record design: ensure the batch records are sufficient to support an FDA inspection and correspond to the process steps described in the IND

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate GMP 落差分析：評估現有 GMP 體系是否足以支持 Phase 1 要求（通常是可以的，但需確認無菌製程、原料管制等關鍵領域）
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate GMP gap analysis: assess whether the existing GMP system is adequate to support Phase 1 requirements (usually it is, but key areas such as aseptic processing and raw material control need to be confirmed)

blocks.zh: 放行程序：確認批次放行標準與 IND 規格一致；CDMO 通常負責 manufacturing release（工廠放行），Sponsor 負責 IND batch disposition（IND 批次最終處置）
blocks.en: Release procedure: confirm that the batch release criteria are consistent with the IND specifications; the CDMO is usually responsible for manufacturing release, while the Sponsor is responsible for IND batch disposition

blocks.zh: 練習思考 — 偏差情境判斷
blocks.en: Exercise: Judging Deviation Scenarios

blocks.zh: CDMO 在製造 Phase 2 臨床批次時發現下列情況，請判斷每種情況的處置優先順序：
blocks.en: A CDMO finds the following situations while manufacturing Phase 2 clinical batches. Decide the handling priority for each:

blocks.zh:
無菌充填環境監控（EM）有一個接觸碟（contact plate）超出警戒限（alert limit）但在行動限（action limit）以下。
→ 依偏差處理 SOP，立即記錄；通知 Sponsor 評估是否影響 IND 報告
blocks.en:
In the aseptic filling environmental monitoring (EM), one contact plate exceeds the alert limit but is below the action limit.
→ Record it immediately per the deviation SOP; notify the Sponsor to assess whether it affects IND reporting

blocks.zh:
已放行並運送給臨床機構的批次，事後發現有效期限標示錯誤（少標了 3 個月）。
→ 高度緊急：可能需要召回（product recall），Sponsor 必須立即評估 FDA 通報義務
blocks.en:
For a batch that has already been released and shipped to the clinical site, it is later discovered that the expiry date on the label is wrong (3 months too short).
→ Highly urgent: a product recall may be needed, and the Sponsor must immediately assess its FDA reporting obligations

blocks.zh:
CDMO 計畫將充填線設備從 A 型灌裝機更換為 B 型，但尚未更新批次記錄模板。
→ 設備變更必須事先通知 Sponsor；Sponsor 評估是否需要提交 IND CMC 修正案（prior approval supplement or annual report）
blocks.en:
The CDMO plans to replace the filling line equipment, changing from a Type A filler to a Type B filler, but has not yet updated the batch record template.
→ The equipment change must be notified to the Sponsor in advance; the Sponsor assesses whether an IND CMC amendment (prior approval supplement or annual report) must be submitted

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Clinical Hold 的 CDMO 影響
blocks.en: Key Point: Impact of a Clinical Hold on the CDMO

blocks.zh: FDA 的 clinical hold（臨床擱置） 是 IND 監管中最嚴重的處置——FDA 可命令暫停或延遲已規劃或進行中的臨床試驗。
blocks.en: An FDA clinical hold is the most severe action in IND oversight: FDA may order the suspension or delay of a planned or ongoing clinical trial.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實際衝擊：
blocks.en: The practical impact on a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 正在製造中的批次可能被要求暫停放行
blocks.en: Batches in manufacture may be put on hold for release

blocks.zh: 已製造完成的批次可能無法繼續出貨給臨床機構
blocks.en: Batches already manufactured may not be shipped to clinical sites

blocks.zh: CDMO 可能需要協助 Sponsor 準備 FDA 要求的 clinical hold response（通常有 30 天期限）
blocks.en: The CDMO may need to help the Sponsor prepare the clinical hold response requested by FDA (usually with a 30-day deadline)

blocks.zh: 整個臨床計畫的延誤成本可達每週數百萬美元
blocks.en: The cost of delay to the whole clinical program can reach millions of dollars per week

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 CDMO 的 GMP 合規性和快速偏差通報機制，對於藥物開發程序的整體時程至關重要。
blocks.en: This is why a CDMO's GMP compliance and rapid deviation reporting mechanism are critical to the overall timeline of the drug development program.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: IND 的本質： 依據 FD&C Act §505(i) 設立，是啟動人體試驗的「通知申請」而非「批准文件」——提交後 30 天自動生效，除非 FDA 發出臨床擱置（clinical hold）
blocks.en: The nature of an IND: Established under FD&C Act §505(i), it is a "notification request" to begin human trials, not an "approval document"; it goes into effect automatically 30 days after submission unless FDA imposes a clinical hold

blocks.zh: IND 觸發三要件： 藥品未獲上市批准 + 用於人體試驗 + 跨州運輸；三者同時成立方須申請 IND
blocks.en: Three conditions that trigger an IND: the drug is not approved for marketing + it is used in human trials + it is shipped across state lines; an IND is needed only when all three are met

blocks.zh: 關鍵豁免： 已上市藥品用於同適應症同族群的臨床觀察（§312.2(a) lawful marketing exemption）；符合條件的 BA/BE 研究（§312.2(b)(1)）；豁免 IND 但 IRB 審查與知情同意義務不變
blocks.en: Key exemptions: clinical investigation of a lawfully marketed drug for the same indication and population (§312.2(a) lawful marketing exemption); qualifying BA/BE studies (§312.2(b)(1)); an IND exemption leaves IRB review and informed consent obligations unchanged

blocks.zh: Phase 遞進： Phase 1（20–80 人，安全性，phase-appropriate GMP）→ Phase 2（100–300 人，探索療效）→ Phase 3（300–3000+ 人，完整商業 CGMP，製程驗證）；CMC 要求隨 Phase 逐步升級
blocks.en: Phase progression: Phase 1 (20-80 subjects, safety, phase-appropriate GMP) → Phase 2 (100-300 subjects, exploratory efficacy) → Phase 3 (300-3000+ subjects, full commercial CGMP, process validation); CMC requirements step up with each phase

blocks.zh: CDMO 的核心義務： 依 IND CMC 規格製造 → 偏差即時通報 Sponsor → 製程變更事先告知 → 維持完整可供稽查的製造紀錄 → 支持 Sponsor 履行所有 IND 申報義務
blocks.en: Core obligations of a CDMO: manufacture according to the IND CMC specifications → report deviations to the Sponsor promptly → give advance notice of process changes → maintain complete, inspection-ready manufacturing records → support the Sponsor in meeting all IND reporting obligations
